# Confirm opportunity drafts reopen only once after repeated keyboard activation

## What & Why
Answer draft recovery now guards against rapid repeated Enter and Space activation. The opportunity recovery flow has a separate form and state path, so it should have the same regression protection against duplicate forms, notices, or unstable recovered values.

## Done looks like
- Rapid repeated Enter and Space activation leaves exactly one opportunity form open.
- The recovered company, role, and other draft values remain unchanged.
- The recovery notice clears and the single success announcement remains stable.
